text:
It makes complete sense that you're feeling conflicted. On one side, there's the relief of knowing someone is listening and cares; on the other, the weight of your stress makes it hard to believe that reaching out will actually change anything.

You mentioned earlier that your professor offered help today. In a past conversation, you shared a similar moment where you were considering dropping a physics course because you felt unsupported, but after talking things through, you decided to try reaching out to a professor instead. That step turned out to be brave, even if it felt daunting at the time.

Would you be open to sharing what specifically worries you about whether this new offer from your professor could make a difference? Or would you prefer to focus on how you're feeling right now without worrying about the outcome yet?
